sections.label: National Stadium venue and purpose
sections.summary: Both concerts were held at the National Stadium in the Singapore Sports Hub, which seats 55,000 and was meant mainly for sporting and community events.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Both concerts were held at a stunning venue – the modern National Stadium nestled in the Singapore Sports Hub, the facility and engineering marvel that can seat as many as 55,000 was meant to host, first and foremost, world-class sporting competitions and other community events.

sections.label: Team Singapore medal results
sections.summary: Team Singapore won 157 SEA Games medals and 44 Para Games medals, with Shanti Pereira setting a 200 metres national record and taking 100 and 200 metres golds.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Team Singapore fought hard and secured 157 medals in the SEA games and 44 in the Para Games.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Sprint queen Shanti Pereira set a new national record for the 200 metres on her way to a double gold for the 100 metres and 200 metres.

sections.label: Singapore medal count ranking
sections.summary: Singapore placed seventh among 11 nations in total medal count for both the SEA Games and Para Games.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Our SEA Games and Para Games performance placed us seventh among the 11 nations in total medal count for both.

sections.label: Sports Hub PPP takeover
sections.summary: The Sports Hub lasted about a dozen years as a PPP before the Government announced SportSG would take over its ownership and management.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: Yet, after launching to much fanfare in 2014 and as the then largest PPP project in the world, the Sports Hub would last only about a dozen years as a PPP.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: Around mid-June last year, the Government announced that SportSG would take over the ownership and management of the Sports Hub, stating that this would serve the interests of Singapore and Singaporeans better.

sections.label: Sports Hub cost overrun
sections.summary: Costs overran the original $650 million to $800 million estimate, reaching $1.3 billion, twice the low-end estimate, while delays were plausibly due to external factors.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: Some of these, such as the delayed construction and launch due to the global financial crisis of 2008, were plausibly due to external factors, beyond the control of the consortium.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: But costs significantly overran the original estimate of $650 million to $800 million, eventually clocking in at $1.3 billion – twice the low-end estimate.

sections.label: Ministerial answers on Sports Hub
sections.summary: Grace Fu said SportSG monitored SHPL closely, and in 2019 declined detailed lessons, saying the first major PPP offered learning.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: In a response to a Parliamentary Question posed in 2017 expressing concerns about the project, then-Minister for Community, Culture and Youth Grace Fu only revealed that SportSG was "in constant communication with Sports Hub Private Limited (SHPL)…   has a dedicated team of officers who monitor SHPL's performance closely and holistically." When I asked in 2019 if there were lessons to be learnt from the episode, she declined to answer in detail, merely offering that being the "first major PPP that the Government has done, we can all learn from the process".

sections.label: DBFO public-private partnership template
sections.summary: The prototypical template is a design-build-finance-operate one, with all aspects falling on the private sector and the Government dealing with political and regulatory risks.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: The prototypical template is a design-build-finance-operate (DBFO) one, where all aspects of the DBFO fall on the private sector with the Government dealing with political and regulatory risks.

sections.label: SMRT and Tuaspring outcomes
sections.summary: SMRT was returned to direct Government management in 2016 after repeated service disruptions, and the Tuaspring Integrated Water and Power Plant underwent debt restructuring in 2019.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: SMRT was returned to direct Government management in 2016 after repeated service disruptions and the Tuaspring Integrated Water and Power Plant had to undergo debt restructuring in 2019.

sections.label: Minister Tong on PPP choice
sections.summary: Minister Tong said the PPP model was chosen because of the unprecedented scale and complexity of the sports infrastructural project and insufficient local expertise.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: Minister Tong alluded to this, stating that the PPP model was ultimately chosen because of the "unprecedented scale and complexity of such a major sports infrastructural project and the limitations at the time of not sufficient depth and breadth of such expertise in Singapore, including in the private sector".

sections.label: Minister Tong on PPP partners
sections.summary: Minister Tong declared that the entire project design, planning and construction were borne by the PPP partners and the structure let the Government mitigate risks.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: Minister Tong proudly declared that the “entire project design, planning and construction were borne by the PPP partners and the structure also allowed the Government to mitigate the risks of such a major project undertaking".

sections.label: Sports budget and Sports Hub costs
sections.summary: Budget estimates show SportSG expenditures, a separate sports programmes budget line, about $556 million for sport, and Sports Hub capital grants and a $1.4 billion charge.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: In the latest Budget estimates, SportSG currently accounts for the ongoing expenditures of a little less than $391 million, with development expenditures of close to $123 million.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: There is a separate budget line for sports programmes, with an operating expenditure of $41 million and development expenditure of $470,000.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: Taken together, we devote just about $556 million, or half a percent of total fiscal expenditures, to sport.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: Of this, the Sports Hub consumed around $57 million in fiscal 2022, in the form of capital grants.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: There was an extraordinary development expenditure charge of close to $1.4 billion in fiscal 2022, which, presumably, was the upfront termination fee.

sections.label: Sports spending inefficiency and speeches
sections.summary: Poor management of sports facilities is symptomatic of general inefficiency in public sports spending, which contributed to PPP failure and poorer sporting outcomes.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: The poor management of sports facilities is merely symptomatic of a more general inefficiency of public spending in sports, which, in turn, not only contributed to a failure of the PPP, but spills over into poorer sporting outcomes as well.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: This is not quite the overkill that it seems to be since, as mentioned earlier, football is a sport that almost every Singaporean connects with.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: They will also deal with different aspects: Mr Tan on how we can revitalise our Singapore Premier League, starting from the grassroots level; and Mr Faisal on how we can help our Singapore National team recover from its current malaise.

sections.label: Team Singapore SEA Games medals
sections.summary: Team Singapore won 158 medals at the SEA Games and 44 medals at the ASEAN Para Games.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: In doing so, we not only provide them with the security of knowing that our country has their back when they compete, but even after they do, which, in turn, allows them to push themselves before they even start.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: It also speaks to how, as a society, we should be taking care of all segments of our society, even when those segments may have faded away from the public limelight.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: At the SEA Games, our Team Singapore had bagged a total of 158 medals: 51 golds, 43 silvers and 64 bronzes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Meanwhile, at the ASEAN Para Games, our Team Singapore had brought back 12 golds, 15 silvers and 17 bronzes, totalling 44 medals.

sections.label: Men's football FIFA ranking drop
sections.summary: The men's national team is ranked 158th, 85 places below its 1993 peak ranking.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Our men's national team is currently ranked at 158th place.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: At the peak of our FIFA ranking, our men's football national team in 1993 was made up of popular footballers, such as Fandi Ahmad, V Sundramoorthy, Malek Awab, Nazri Nasir, Rafi Ali and other excellent players.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: This means that in the three decades since we achieved our highest ranking, we have dropped by a remarkably disappointing 85 places, which is also 31 places below our average.

sections.label: FAS and MCCY strategic plans
sections.summary: The passage asks FAS or MCCY for updates on strategic plans, noting an Under-17 league and talent scout training.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Second, I would like to, once again, ask for updates from FAS or MCCY on the strategic plans in achieving this realistic goal or aspirational target.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: I note that there are plans to launch an Under-17 league in 2024, and also to train talent scouts, which were announced in May 2023 during a consultation exercise.

sections.label: AFC Asian Cup qualification history
sections.summary: The passage proposes aiming to qualify for the 2036 AFC Asian Cup, noting 1984 was the only final round qualification.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Before we even think about the World Cup, why not we first try to qualify for the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) Asian Cup in 2036?

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Historically, our national football team has participated in the AFC Cup since its inception.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: However, the only time we have ever qualified for the final round was in 1984 – as the host country.

sections.label: Unleash The Roar announcement
sections.summary: In 2021, FAS announced the introduction of "Unleash The Roar" (UTR).

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: In 2021, FAS announced the introduction of "Unleash The Roar" (UTR).

sections.label: MCCY study visits and reviews
sections.summary: The passage asks whether MCCY has studied countries with similar population constraints, citing Iceland and Croatia.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: As for our other unique features, I would like to know if the Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth (MCCY) has conducted study visits and reviews of countries who face similar population constraints as Singapore and what lessons have been learnt and perhaps implemented into our own development planning.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: I had cited Iceland, whose football team made it to the 2018 World Cup despite their small population.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The Croatian football team joined FIFA in 1994, ranked 125th.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: They rose to third place with their first World Cup appearance in 1998, making them the fastest, most volatile ascension in FIFA ranking history as well as the youngest team to ever occupy the top 10 of the world ranking.

sections.label: FAS review panel SEA Games
sections.summary: In May 2023, FAS announced it will convene a review panel after the dismal SEA Games performance.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: In May 2023, FAS announced that it will convene a review panel after the dismal performance at the SEA Games.

sections.label: Soh Rui Yong Asian Games non-selection
sections.summary: A resident notes Soh Rui Yong, a SEA Games silver medalist, was not selected for the upcoming Asian Games in October.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Despite starting the sport of fencing only a few years ago, she brought home, as part of the foil team, a gold medal from the recent SEA Games.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: I speak with reference to one of my residents, SEA Games silver medalist, Soh Rui Yong, and his non-selection for the upcoming Asian Games in October.

sections.label: FAS football ban reduced on appeal
sections.summary: He was banned by FAS from football for 12 months, cut to seven months on appeal.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Once, he was banned by the Football Association of Singapore (FAS) from football for 12 months, with the sentence cut to seven months on appeal.

sections.label: Soh Rui Yong records and selection history
sections.summary: Rui Yong holds national records, won 10,000 metres silver with sportsmanship, and was left out of the 2019 and 2022 SEA Games by SNOC.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Rui Yong is the national record holder for the 5,000 metres, 10,000 metres, half marathon and marathon events.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Not only did he win silver for the 10,000 metres, he earned plaudits in Singapore and the region for a spontaneous display of sportsmanship, passing his own cup of water to his Indonesian opponent, whom he was in neck-to-neck with, when the Indonesian dropped his water bottle.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Prior to the last SEA Games, Rui Yong was left out of the SEA Games by the SNOC in 2019 and 2022 for disciplinary reasons, when he was at the prime of his athletic life.

sections.label: Asian Games non-selection due to online comments
sections.summary: Publicly available information indicates the latest Asian Games non-selection results from public comments he made online.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: From publicly available information, the latest non-selection for the Asian Games is a result of public comments he made online.

sections.label: Prior cases of athletes representing Singapore
sections.summary: A Silat exponent represented Singapore despite a 2022 drink-driving conviction, and a swimmer was previously disciplined for controlled drugs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: For example, a Silat exponent was allowed to represent Singapore at the last SEA Games despite a drink-driving conviction in 2022; a swimmer who had won a silver medal at the last SEA Games had previously been disciplined for consuming controlled drugs and had his prestigious spexScholarship suspended for one month.

sections.label: Soh Rui Yong and SNOC
sections.summary: Speaker says SNOC looks petty to many Singaporeans and hopes officials intercede so Singapore sport does not cut off its nose to spite its face.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: But in the eyes of many Singaporeans, on the Soh Rui Yong matter, SNOC, as the highest sporting body in Singapore, comes out looking petty, even as many also believe that Rui Yong needs to learn from the past and draw a line and focus on his sporting career.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: It is time to move on from the previous episode involving the lawsuit and I hope the Ministry officials, if not the Minister-in-charge of sports, can intercede to prevent parties from reaching a point where Singapore sport cuts off its nose to spite its own face.

sections.label: Support for emerging sports
sections.summary: A second area of focus should be support for emerging sports that resonate with youth, such as floorball and tchoukball.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: A second area of focus should be the provision of support for emerging sports that resonate with our youth, such as floorball and tchoukball.

sections.label: Community sports investment
sections.summary: The speaker proposes the Government continue investing in local sports facilities and increase funding for community-level coaching programmes.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: To strengthen community sports, I propose that our Government continue to invest in local sports facilities and increase funding for coaching programmes at the community level.

sections.label: Football development centres
sections.summary: The speaker looks forward to national and junior football development centres providing structured training and competition opportunities.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: They need to compete regularly and at the right levels.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: I look forward to the setting up of the national and junior football development centres to provide such structured opportunities for training and competition.

sections.label: SPL match liveliness review
sections.summary: The speaker says matches are no longer as lively and urges relevant parties to review what more can be done for the SPL.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: Sadly, the matches are no longer as lively as they used to be and I urge the relevant parties to review what more can be done for the SPL.

sections.label: Inclusive sporting ecosystem journey
sections.summary: The speaker says Singapore is on the right path but must ensure its journey cherishes the whole sporting ecosystem from grassroots to international acclaim.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: We are, indeed, on the right path, but we must make a conscious effort to ensure that our journey is both encompassing and enriching – cherishing every aspect of our sporting ecosystem from grassroots participation to international acclaim.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: It is about shaping a resilient, inclusive society.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: It is about the dreams we foster, the communities we build and the nation we envision.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: It is about the very essence of who we are and who we aspire to be.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: In this pursuit, let us remember: our goal is not to conquer the field, but to conquer the odds.

sections.label: SPL and SFL funding
sections.summary: FAS 2022 report shows SPL clubs received $8,896,804 in grants and FAS SPL expenses were $13,669,626, versus $147,404 for SFL and women's football.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: According to the Football Association of Singapore (FAS) Annual Report for 2022, Singapore Premier League (SPL) clubs received $8,896,804 in grants while FAS' total expenses for SPL amounted to $13,669,626, inclusive of the state grants.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: In comparison, FAS had only incurred combined expenses of $147,404 for the Singapore Football League Divisions 1 and 2, together with Women's Football, inclusive of the Women's Domestic League.

sections.label: Promotion and relegation proposal
sections.summary: The passage suggests reintroducing promotion and relegation, with bottom SPL clubs relegated and replaced by top SFL clubs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: Perhaps, we can increase competition and standards at the SPL as well as at the SFL by reintroducing the prospects of promotion and relegation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: For example, the bottom one or two SPL clubs will be automatically relegated, to be replaced by, say, the top one or two clubs in the SFL.

sections.label: Sheltered street courts funding
sections.summary: The passage suggests SportSG could fund roof shelters at neighbourhood street courts and sheltered street courts atop multi-storey car parks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: Perhaps, SportSG can fund the building of roof shelters at neighbourhood street courts and the building of sheltered street courts on the top levels of some of the multi-storey car parks.

sections.label: Unleash The Roar talent identification
sections.summary: The passage states FAS has continued to identify talents from under eight to under 15 under Unleash The Roar!.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: Under the current Unleash The Roar! initiative, it is laudable that FAS has continued to identify talents who are under eight to under 15.

sections.label: Bio-banding by Khamis-Roche method
sections.summary: The passage suggests classifying youths by predicted height and weight, the Khamis-Roche method, rather than by age.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: One possible solution is to adopt the concept of bio-banding by classifying youths according to predicted height and weight – also known as the Khamis-Roche method – rather than by age.

sections.label: FIFA Statutes independence
sections.summary: The passage cites FIFA Statutes Article 17.1 requiring members to manage affairs independently, giving examples of funding youth coaches and grassroots football space without interference.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: Article 17.1 of the FIFA Statutes states that "Each Member shall manage its affairs independently and with no influence from third parties." To illustrate by way of suggestions or examples – providing the funding to hire youth coaches but not be involved in interviewing the coaches themselves and rather to leave the professionals to make the decisions; providing space for grassroots football but not dictate the rules of the leagues.

sections.label: Four goals for Singapore sports
sections.summary: The speaker argues that disparate goals are not mutually exclusive and proposes embracing four goals for Singapore sports at the national level.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: I will argue that such goals are not mutually exclusive and sufficient weight can be given to disparate goals.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: I would argue that we should embrace four goals for Singapore sports at the national level.

sections.label: Focusing support on successful sports
sections.summary: The speaker argues for focusing support on sports where Singapore has done well, using top performers as coaches and role models and drawing more funding and attention.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: One important thrust in our sporting efforts should be to focus on those sports where Singapore has done well so as to focus support on our athletes there so that they sustain and surpass their achievements, analyse and act on the reasons for that success, have our National Sports Associations (NSAs) engage these top performers aggressively to be coaches, advisors and role models to inspire others to take up the sport, and stimulate media coverage and draw more attention and audience numbers to these less well-known sports.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Where we have strong national champions in a sport, there lies the basis for stimulating audience interest and, thus, bring in commercial participation on the back of that.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: I am not claiming that nothing has been done by the Government for these less well-known sports, but I am arguing for a more aggressive approach of using our resources to study our regional and world-class athletes in these sports, try to spark more people entering these sports, focus more of our funding dollars on such sports where we are really good and draw more attention and interest to these sports, not only the famous ones.

sections.label: Singapore soft-tip darts scene
sections.summary: Paul noted the soft-tip darts scene has exploded in Singapore, estimating around 20,000 players and calling it one of the world's most lucrative and active.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: In the same article, Paul noted that the soft-tip darts scene has exploded in Singapore, too.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: He estimated that there were around 20,000 players here. "Singapore has one of the most lucrative and active darts scenes in the world," he said.

sections.label: Darts World Cup invitation, no NSA
sections.summary: Lim said he and Harith owed their PDC World Cup participation to a personal invitation, and no darts NSA appears to exist.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Lim revealed that he and Harith – "Singapore's best steel-tip player" – owed their participation in the PDC World Cup to a personal invitation from organisers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: I tried to find out if an NSA for darts still exists and it does not appear that one does.

sections.label: Singapore hosted International 2022
sections.summary: Singapore recently hosted the world's top tournament in this sport, the International 2022, with a prize pool above S$25 million.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Indeed, Singapore recently hosted the world's top tournament in this sport – the International 2022 – with a prize pool of above S$25 million.

sections.label: Farhanna Farid deadlift world record
sections.summary: On 6 June 2022, Singaporean Farhanna Farid set a world record in the open U-52kg deadlift at the World Open Classic Powerlifting Championships in Sun City.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: On 6 June 2022, Singaporean Farhanna Farid set a world record in the open U-52kg deadlift at the World Open Classic Powerlifting Championships in Sun City.

sections.label: Powerlifting crowdfunding and no NSA funding
sections.summary: Matthew and Marcus crowdfunded tickets home in 2017 after a Minsk competition, receiving no SportSG funding because powerlifting lacked an NSA.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: And yet, in 2017, Matthew and Marcus had to crowdfund plane tickets home after missing their flight from Minsk, Belarus, where they were participating in a competition where Matthew had set a new world squat record.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: They did not receive any funding from SportSG because powerlifting does not, or did not, have an NSA, though having said that, an official at the then Powerlifting Singapore helped them to start the crowdfunding campaign and Singapore's Ministry of Foreign Affairs asked the airline to lower the fare for both of them.

sections.label: Sailing Olympic first for Singapore
sections.summary: Cecilia Low and Kimberley Lim were the top Asian team at the Olympics and won one race among 21 countries, an Olympic first.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: In sailing, Cecilia Low and Kimberley Lim came in as the top Asian team at the Olympics, also winning one race where 21 countries competed – an Olympic first.

sections.label: Early investment in talented Singaporeans
sections.summary: The passage asks whether Singapore can identify and invest more in talented Singaporeans, noting Joseph Schooling's US training cost over $1 million.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Can we identify early and invest more in the handful of those Singaporeans who are truly talented and have the potential to be world-class or at least tops in the region?

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: It is well-known that the cost of Joseph Schooling's intense training in the USA prior to winning an Olympic Gold medal for Singapore was well over $1 million – well over.

sections.label: Early funding calibrated to potential
sections.summary: The passage says good results attract state funding but early funding is needed, and urges SportSG and NSAs to identify and fund talented athletes early.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: State funding can be attracted if good results are achieved but to get good results requires funding at an early age.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: I am aware that there are scholarships available, like the SOF-Peter Lim Scholarship and the NUS Sports Scholarship.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: But SportSG and the NSAs should give serious thought to how truly talented athletes can be identified and funded early enough in their careers to achieve their full potential, with funding calibrated to potential.

sections.label: Centralised cadre of talent scouts
sections.summary: The passage asks whether a centralised cadre of trained talent scouts could evaluate individuals or visit schools proactively.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: If such training is not practicable, can there be a centralised cadre of talent scouts who have such training, who can be called in to evaluate individuals or who visit schools proactively for observation?

sections.label: Sports business management and marketing skills
sections.summary: The passage asks whether enough is done to train sports business professionals and attract Singaporeans or foreign professionals, citing US Superbowl advertising.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Are we doing enough to train a cadre of professionals who have the necessary sports business management and marketing skillsets?

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Can we attract Singaporeans who have an interest in this field to take up sponsored training abroad, or perhaps attract foreign professionals in the short term, aiming for some skills transfer, perhaps using ONE Pass, for example?

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: If you look at the US Superbowl, for example, sometimes, the commercial advertisements compete with the on-field athletic performances for public attention.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: This is important if we want to make the sports industry sustainable and attractive to athletes and other sports professionals and administrators on the financial level, as opposed to being a government-dependent industry where one is expected to sacrifice financial sustainability for love of sport.

sections.label: Team SG medal haul
sections.summary: The 558-strong contingent won 51 gold, 43 silver and 64 bronze medals.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Amongst the 558-strong contingent, our Team SG athletes bagged 51 gold, 43 silver and 64 bronze medals.

sections.label: Singapore's SEA Games ranking
sections.summary: With 51 golds, eight Games records, 17 national records and 40 personal bests, Singapore ranked sixth among 11 ASEAN countries.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: With 51 gold medals, eight Games records, 17 national records and 40 personal best results, Singapore ranked sixth amongst 11 ASEAN countries, and not seventh as mentioned by Assoc Prof Jamus Lim earlier on.

sections.label: High-Performance Sports investment
sections.summary: The Government invests about $70 million annually on the High-Performance Sports system to support national athletes and sports associations.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: To support the development of national athletes and national sports associations, the Government has already invested about $70 million annually on the High-Performance Sports system.

sections.label: Men and women's team medals
sections.summary: The men and women's teams won four golds, two silvers and three bronzes, their best since SEA Games 2017.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: The men and women’s teams won four golds, two silvers and three bronzes – the best results since SEA Games 2017.

sections.label: STTA government grant funding
sections.summary: About two-thirds of STTA's annual expenses are funded by Government grants.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: In STTA, approximately two-thirds of our annual expenses are funded by Government grants.

sections.label: Izaac Quek's world ranking
sections.summary: Izaac Quek rose from world No 239 in January 2023 to No 62 as of 4 July 2023.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: As an example, Izaac Quek’s world ranking has risen rapidly from world No 239 in January 2023 to No 62 as of 4 July 2023 – two days ago – giving him a good chance to qualify for the Paris Olympics.

sections.label: Funds for national paddlers
sections.summary: Funds are set aside for full-time national paddlers with three continuous years of service, and trust funds for Olympic national paddlers' university studies.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Funds will be set aside for full-time national paddlers who have completed at least three continuous years of service.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: In addition, we have also set aside trust funds for high achieving national paddlers who have represented Singapore in the Olympics to further their studies in the universities.

sections.label: Sports for everyone, STTA plan
sections.summary: Sports are for everyone, not just glory; the STTA President serves pro bono so young players can achieve dreams, and STTA has a plan.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Having said that, we must also bear in mind that sports are for everyone and not just about glory.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: I chose to serve as the President of STTA pro bono because I want young players to be able to believe in their passion, achieve their sporting dreams and eventually become world-class paddlers who can win Olympic medals against all odds.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: STTA has a plan, is constantly improving, works with partners within the ecosystem and sets goals that are attainable to inspire our youths.

sections.label: Seventh in total medal count
sections.summary: Both the regular team and Paralympic team ranked seventh in total medal count, with gold medals counted differentially.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: Exactly the same as our normal athlete team in the sense that they were both ranked seventh in total medal count and Ms Poh Li San mentioned that the regular team secured six, which is correct, if you look at the fact that gold medals are counted differentially.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: But in the statement that I made earlier on, it was about total medal count.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: And in total medal count, we had the same performance, which was seventh in both cases of the regular SEA Games as well as the Paralympic Games.

sections.label: Silat drink-driving incident timing
sections.summary: The silat athlete's drink-driving incident occurred on 27 November 2022, while the SEA Games silat competition was on 18 May 2023, outside the Code of Conduct.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay
sentences.text: Regarding our silat athletes and swimmers, I just want to clarify that for the silat athlete, whether he is aware that the drink-driving incident actually happened on 27 November 2022 and the silat competition at the SEA Games actually happened on 18 May 2023.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay
sentences.text: So, that falls outside the Code of Conduct and the Athletes' Agreement.

sections.label: Podcast disparaging comments
sections.summary: After returning, he did a podcast and made disparaging comments about SNOC and his teammate.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay
sentences.text: When he came back, he did a podcast and he made disparaging comments not only about SNOC, but about his teammate as well.

sections.label: Momota gambling ban, Soh Rui Yong
sections.summary: Kento Momota, ranked No 1, gambled, broke the Code of Conduct and missed the 2016 Rio Olympics; Soh Rui Yong can still compete at Singapore Athletics sanctioned meets.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay
sentences.text: I think in 2016, Kento Momota, for badminton, he was ranked No 1.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay
sentences.text: He was gambling and he broke the Code of Conduct, and he was also not allowed to attend the 2016 Rio Olympic Games, even though he was ranked No 1.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay
sentences.text: But I think to say that Soh Rui Yong was not allowed to compete, he can still compete, not at the major games, but at Singapore Athletics sanctioned meets.

sections.label: Sports spending and performance data
sections.summary: Assoc Prof Jamus Lim presented data on countries' sporting excellence and government spending relative to GDP per capita, with Singapore below the trendline.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera
sentences.text: My colleague Assoc Prof Jamus Lim presented data on the performance of different countries in sporting excellence, government spending relative to gross domestic product (GDP) per capita.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera
sentences.text: And I think Singapore is below the trendline in that.

sections.label: Singapore swimming gold medal gaps
sections.summary: High performance takes time; Singapore's men's swimming team had no SEA Games gold between Ang Peng Siong in 1993 and 2001.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay
sentences.text: There are many different factors and, if you ask me, high performance takes time.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay
sentences.text: We celebrate the accomplishments of our aquatic fraternity; we came back with 23 gold medals at the Southeast Asian Games.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay
sentences.text: But there was a time when our men's team did not have a gold medal after Ang Peng Siong, 1993, where he swam in the 50-metre freestyle.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay
sentences.text: The next time the Singapore men's team won a gold medal at the Southeast Asian Games was 2001.

sections.label: Facilities and high-performance programming
sections.summary: Despite many facilities, programming needs to kick in, with high performance targeting the 2029 SEA Games or 2028 Olympics.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay
sentences.text: Although right now we have a lot of wonderful facilities, the programming needs to kick in.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay
sentences.text: And if you look at high performance, you are looking at 2029 Southeast Asian Games or the Olympics in 2028.

sections.label: spexBusiness Network corporate partners
sections.summary: The spexBusiness Network has 60 corporate partners across 15 industries supporting Team Singapore athletes with work positions and post-competition career transition.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Today, the spexBusiness Network, within the Singapore Sport Institute’s (SSI) Sport Excellence, or spex, framework, consists of 60 corporate partners across 15 industries.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: These corporate partners support Team Singapore athletes during their active sports career, offering full-time or part-time or internship positions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: These companies are committed to athlete-friendly work practices that support active athletes in their sporting ambitions, while helping them develop professionally and gain valuable experience at the workplace.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: I am heartened that the spexBusiness Network also offers support for professional development and opportunities to prepare retiring athletes for a smooth transition into a post-competition career and it would be good if the Government could provide an update in terms of how many athletes have benefited from this programme.

sections.label: Proposed amendment to the Motion
sections.summary: Citing engagement with sports stakeholders, the speaker proposes an amendment to the Motion, saying it could be limiting in scope.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Over the many years, I have had the privilege to interact and engage with national and professional athletes, sports administrators, Government officials, corporate sponsors, international sport broadcasters – almost every stakeholder in the sports industry and the sports ecosystem.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: So, it is with this personal passion and professional background in mind that I feel that the present Motion, as it stands, could be a little limiting in terms of its scope.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: For instance, hon Members Ms Poh Li San and Dr Wan Rizal spoke about the broader objectives of high-performance sports, which are to help our athletes achieve their best potential.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: In this light, Mdm Deputy Speaker, with your permission, may I humbly, therefore, propose an amendment to the Motion?

sections.label: Inserting including in Motion
sections.summary: Inserting "including" before the 32nd SEA Games and 12th ASEAN Para Games recognises that celebration of athletes goes beyond these games.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David
sentences.text: The first point on inserting "including" before "at the 32nd Southeast Asian Games and the 12th ASEAN Para Games" recognises that any celebration of accomplishments of our athletes and para-athletes goes beyond these games, and I think Members in this House would agree with me.

sections.label: Amendment on continuing sports reviews
sections.summary: An amendment deletes "undertake a" and inserts "continue its" to recognise ongoing reviews and goal-setting for high-performance sports.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David
sentences.text: The next point, Madam, is in relation to deleting "undertake a" and inserting "continue its".

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David
sentences.text: This recognises the continuing nature of reviews and goal-setting for our high-performance sports and our sports system, regardless of any Motion raised.

sections.label: Original Motion's single objective
sections.summary: The original Motion mentioned one of several objectives, such as goals for sporting success, possibly meaning medals or tournament qualifications.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David
sentences.text: The original Motion mentioned just one of several objectives, for example, goals for sporting success, where the last limb can be construed as being about medals or qualifications for international tournaments.

sections.label: Three amendments to the Motion
sections.summary: Three amendments by Mr Darryl David are listed, and debate on the original and other amendments may proceed simultaneously as a single question.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David
sentences.text: I look forward to support for this amendment from my colleagues, also from the Workers' Party, too.

sentences.speaker: Mdm Deputy Speaker
sentences.text: There are three amendments proposed by Mr Darryl David to the Motion. "In line 1, after the words 'athletes and para-athletes', to insert 'including'; In line 3, to delete 'undertake a' and insert 'continue its'; and The third amendment, in line 4, to delete 'clear, achievable goals for sporting success' and insert 'our goals in sports'." It may be convenient that the debate on the original and on any other amendments moved by Members be proceeded with simultaneously as a debate on a single question.

sections.label: TeamSG gold medal counts
sections.summary: TeamSG won 51 gold medals at the SEA Games and 12 at the ASEAN Para Games, the third and fourth highest away from home.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: TeamSG's 51 gold medals at the SEA Games and 12 gold medals at the ASEAN Para Games are the third and fourth highest away from home soil in our history respectively.

sections.label: Athlete selection review controversy
sections.summary: Athlete selection for international competitions is under review, with marathoner Soh Rui Yong omitted from the Asian Games team over social media comments.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: One area of review in our sporting ecosystem is in the selection of athletes to represent Singapore at international sporting competitions, such as the SEA Games and Asian Games.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: This has been the source of some controversy recently, with marathoner Soh Rui Yong being omitted from the national team for the forthcoming Asian Games in Hangzhou because of his controversial comments on social media.

sections.label: Call for selection objectivity
sections.summary: Disqualifying an athlete for non-performance reasons is called a serious matter, with calls for greater objectivity and transparency in selection criteria.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: We think this is a very serious matter to disqualify an athlete for non-performance reasons.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: We call for greater objectivity and transparency in the selection criteria for athletes to represent Singapore at major sporting events.

sections.label: NS deferment for male athletes
sections.summary: PSP supports long NS deferments for a small number of talented male athletes to reach full athletic potential and bring glory to the nation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: In the area of sports, PSP supports allowing a small number of our most talented male athletes to receive long deferments for NS so that they can reach their full athletic potential and maximise the opportunity to bring glory to our nation.

sections.label: Athlete training and tournament demands
sections.summary: High-performance athletes train 12 to 30 hours weekly, with one NSA guideline of 28 hours and 27 tournaments yearly for 16-year-old males, requiring overseas travel during school term.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: High-performance athletes are generally expected to put in between 12 hours and 30 hours of high-intensity training each week, with the number of hours increasing with age.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: One local national sports association (NSA) provides a training volume guideline of 28 hours a week and 27 tournaments a year for 16-year-old male athletes in their sport.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Athletes need to travel overseas, usually during the school term, to take part in tournaments which are necessary for gaining competition experience and earning ranking points.

sections.label: Earnings in golf and tennis
sections.summary: Even in high-paying sports like golf and tennis, only athletes ranked around the top 150 worldwide earn enough prize money to support themselves.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Even if we look at some of the highest paying sports like golf and tennis, only athletes ranked in the top 150 or so in the world earn enough prize money to support themselves.

sections.label: USC athletes at Tokyo Olympics
sections.summary: The University of Southern California had 65 past, present or incoming student athletes at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics, compared to 23 from Singapore, winning 11 gold medals.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The University of Southern California, for example, had 65 past, present or incoming student athletes competing in the 2020 Tokyo Olympics, compared to 23 from Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: USC athletes collectively won 11 gold medals in those games.

sections.label: Division I full-ride scholarships
sections.summary: Division I athletes are sometimes offered full-ride athletics scholarships covering tuition, housing, meals, transport, apparel, equipment, coaching, sports science and academic tutoring.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Division I athletes are sometimes offered "full-ride" athletics scholarships.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: These can cover tuition fees, housing, meals, transport, apparel, equipment coaching, sports science expertise and even academic tutoring for the athletes.

sections.label: Telecasting local athletes' matches
sections.summary: Matches featuring local athletes in advanced stages of international competitions should be telecast free-to-air or live-streamed, and major games involving Team Singapore uploaded online.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Matches featuring local athletes in the advanced stages of international competitions should be telecast live on free-to-air television or live-streamed online.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: During major games, all the matches and races where Team Singapore athletes are competing in should be uploaded to an online video platform like MeWatch or YouTube.

sections.label: Parents of athletic youngsters
sections.summary: Parents of talented athletic youngsters should understand their child's motivations and not push them to excel just to DSA into a good school.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: If you are a parent of a talented and athletic youngster, do take the time to listen to and understand your child's motivations and dreams, assess whether they truly love their sport and do not push them to excel in a sport just to "DSA" into a good school or, worse, live your own dreams vicariously through them.

sections.label: Supporting world-class athlete aspirations
sections.summary: Parents should encourage children with world-class athlete aspirations, find available pathways and support them within their means.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: If your child has aspirations to become a world-class athlete, encourage them to pursue their dreams, take the time to find out the available pathways and support them within your means.

sections.label: TeamSG SEA Games medals
sections.summary: TeamSG won 158 medals at the SEA Games and para-athletes brought home 44 medals, the second-best away performance behind the 2017 ASEAN Para Games.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Radin Mas)
sentences.text: TeamSG won a total of 158 medals at the SEA Games while our para-athletes brought home a total of 44 medals.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Radin Mas)
sentences.text: This was our second-best away performance of all time, behind the 2017 ASEAN Para Games.

sections.label: Pesta Sukan 2023
sections.summary: Pesta Sukan 2023 provides amateur sportsmen and women an opportunity to raise their standards through competition, running from 8 July 2023 to National Day at the Singapore Sports Hub.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Radin Mas)
sentences.text: It provides an opportunity, too, for amateur sportsmen and women to get together to raise their own standards through competition.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Radin Mas)
sentences.text: This year’s Pesta Sukan 2023 will commence from this weekend, 8 July 2023, to National Day at the Singapore Sports Hub.

sections.label: Elevating Singapore football standard
sections.summary: FAS should widen talent scouting, partner with professional clubs and leagues worldwide, and provide structured avenues for players to join academies and overseas training.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Radin Mas)
sentences.text: The tournament sees about 2,000 young players every year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Radin Mas)
sentences.text: FAS can and should widen its talent scouting and recruitment systems to encompass the many hidden gems in our community.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Radin Mas)
sentences.text: Third, we must also establish strong partnerships with professional clubs and leagues worldwide to help groom our local talents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Radin Mas)
sentences.text: We need to provide structured avenues for players to join professional academies, participate in overseas training programmes and experience competitive leagues at a higher level.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Radin Mas)
sentences.text: By investing in infrastructure, nurturing young talents, promoting collaborations and benchmarking ourselves against successful football nations and, with the support from the Government, relevant stakeholders and the unwavering passion from the football fraternity and fans, we can, no doubt, elevate the standard of football in Singapore once again.

sections.label: National Sport Participation Survey
sections.summary: SportSG's National Sport Participation Survey found regular sports participation rose to an all-time high of 74% last year, though improvement continues.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: SportSG recently released its National Sport Participation Survey (NSPS), which took place for the five years between 2018 and 2022.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: It tracks sports participation across a few indicators and it is heartening to see that, for once, there appears to be a positive correlation associated with the pandemic: that regular sports participation rates increased to an all-time high of 74% last year.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Yet, we must continue to improve, to look to countries like Norway, where in 2021 a whopping 97% of those aged 16 and above participated in outdoor activities and 86.9% stated that they had participated in various exercise activities.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: We should include measures of sporting success as part of a development dashboard tracking our country's holistic development.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: If we want to shift our focus towards holistic societal well-being rather than keeping a narrow focus on an increasingly outdated measure that is GDP, sports indicators should be one of the first places we should look at.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: This is because, one, access to sports needs to be a right for residents in Singapore, especially as it embodies dignity, equality and other values Singaporeans agree should form the core of our society.

sections.label: Football fan cap and attendance
sections.summary: The Football Association of Singapore capped fans at 5,000 for Team Singapore friendlies at the National Stadium, far below 1970s and 1980s crowds.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: One highly publicised example in recent months was the cap that the Football Association of Singapore applied to limit the number of fans for Team Singapore football friendly matches at the National Stadium to a paltry 5,000.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Apart from being extremely frustrating for fans, attendance numbers today are also a far cry from the regular 50,000-strong crowds during our Malaysian Cup and Super League halcyon days of the 1970s and 1980s.

sections.label: Sports spectatorship in national survey
sections.summary: Sports spectatorship should be studied in the National Sport Participation Survey and treated as a key indicator of national development beyond GDP.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: In view of the above, sports spectatorship should be studied as part of the National Sport Participation Survey (NSPS) and considered a key indicator of national development beyond GDP.

sections.label: Disabled sports participation rate
sections.summary: The last Enabling Masterplan reported that sports participation among persons with disabilities was about 50% in 2019, exceeding the set target.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: For instance, the last Enabling Masterplan reported that the sports participation rate among persons with disabilities was approximately 50% in 2019, exceeding the target that was set.

sections.label: Therapy horse sports access
sections.summary: Riding for the Disabled Association of Singapore has benefited up to 7,000 individuals in over 40 years, but access remains limited and closures may raise costs.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Charities, such as Riding for the Disabled Association of Singapore, do excellent work with children and adults from Special Education (SPED) schools and Social Service Agencies (SSAs), and up to 7,000 individuals have benefited since its inception over 40 years ago.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: But nonetheless, availability and accessibility to such sports remain extremely limited despite the known benefits.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: And I fear that the closure of the Singapore Turf Club, along with the expiry of leases to stables like the Bukit Timah Saddle Club to make way for residential or transport infrastructure, will only make these sports even more expensive and inaccessible to Singaporeans who could benefit tremendously, particularly as some retired race horses do eventually end up working as therapy horses or for other equestrian-related sports at our dwindling number of saddle clubs.

sections.label: Neurodivergent global population estimate
sections.summary: Latest estimates put 10% to 20% of the global population as neurodivergent, a significant group that should not be neglected.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: With latest estimates of 10% to 20% of the global population being neurodivergent, it is a significant group that we should not neglect.

sections.label: Sports access and inclusivity indicators
sections.summary: The speaker hopes for official performance indicators that more explicitly and holistically include access and inclusivity in the sports ecosystem.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: In summary, today, I hope that we can have official performance indicators to more explicitly and holistically include key indicators for access and inclusivity in our sports ecosystem.

sections.label: Contact sports CTE risk
sections.summary: A 2022 study found contact sports players were 68 times more likely to develop CTE, and former English and Welsh rugby players filed a class action lawsuit.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: In a 2022 study, researchers found that players of contact sports, such as American football, rugby and soccer, were 68 times more likely to develop CTE than those who were not.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: In fact, a group of former English and Welsh rugby players have initiated a class action lawsuit against their respective rugby governing bodies, asserting that they failed to protect players sufficiently in the sport, with many ending up with dementia or CTE later in life.

sections.label: Insurance coverage for national athletes
sections.summary: The Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth said insurance covers athletes only while representing Singapore, which the speaker calls inadequate for latent injuries.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: When I asked a Parliamentary Question in January on insurance coverage for national athletes, the basic answer from the Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth is that the coverage is there while the athlete is still representing Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Based on what we know now about sports injuries which are latent or have lifelong consequences, covering athletes only when they represent Singapore is clearly inadequate.

sections.label: Lifetime medical subsidies for athletes
sections.summary: The passage calls for providing all national athletes with medical subsidies for their lifetimes.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Provide all national athletes with medical subsidies for the duration of their lifetimes.

sections.label: Multidisciplinary task force for subsidies
sections.summary: The passage calls for a multidisciplinary task force to work on a scheme giving former national athletes additional subsidies for sports-related treatment in public healthcare institutions.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: To this end, I call for the setting up of a multidisciplinary task force.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The task force will work on a scheme to give additional subsidies to former national athletes for their treatment costs for sports-related conditions so long as the treatment is sought in our public healthcare institutions.

sections.label: Lifetime medical subsidies for athletes
sections.summary: The speaker, as a Singapore citizen, does not want sporting heroes worrying about medical bills and believes lifetime medical subsidies should be seriously considered.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: As a citizen of Singapore, I do not wish to see our sporting heroes worry about their medical bills.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: I believe we should look seriously into providing lifetime medical subsidies for our national athletes.

sections.label: Athletes' mental well-being support
sections.summary: The passage says athletes' mental well-being is crucial amid high public expectations and media scrutiny, and calls for proactive identification and support and mental resilience skills.

sentences.speaker: Mr Xie Yao Quan (Jurong)
sentences.text: While we strive for sports excellence, it is also crucial to take care of our athletes' mental well-being, especially when overly high public expectations are placed on them and when they come under the glare of the mainstream and social media.

sentences.speaker: Mr Xie Yao Quan (Jurong)
sentences.text: We need to be proactive in identifying and supporting athletes who may need help and we need to help our athletes develop the skills and the mental resilience they need to deal with the demands they face, including in their post-athlete careers and lives.

sections.label: Kyra Poh spexScholarship support
sections.summary: Kyra Poh is a world champion and household name supported under the spexScholarship, the first for a sport not in the Major Games.

sentences.speaker: Mr Xie Yao Quan (Jurong)
sentences.text: But 21-year-old Kyra Poh is already a world champion and a household name.

sentences.speaker: Mr Xie Yao Quan (Jurong)
sentences.text: And I am happy to note that she is currently being supported under the spexScholarship, the first for a sport not featured in the Major Games.

sections.label: Tchoukball Association national federation
sections.summary: The Tchoukball Association of Singapore has been a national federation since 2018.

sentences.speaker: Mr Xie Yao Quan (Jurong)
sentences.text: In fact, the Tchoukball Association of Singapore (TBAS) has been a national federation since 2018.

sections.label: Women's tchoukball team world No 1
sections.summary: The national women's tchoukball team became world No 1 for the first time after beating Chinese Taipei at the 2022 Asia Pacific Tchoukball Championships in Malaysia.

sentences.speaker: Mr Xie Yao Quan (Jurong)
sentences.text: In any case, many of us would have heard of our national women's tchoukball team making history by becoming the world No 1 for the first time earlier this year after they won powerhouse Chinese Taipei at the 2022 Asia Pacific Tchoukball Championships in Malaysia.

sections.label: NYSI and SportSG tchoukball support
sections.summary: Tchoukball players use the NYSI gym, where strength and conditioning specialists created a programme, and SportSG provided sport psychology resources for mental preparation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Xie Yao Quan (Jurong)
sentences.text: Our tchoukball players use the gym at the NYSI and the strength and conditioning specialists there have created a programme to help the team.

sentences.speaker: Mr Xie Yao Quan (Jurong)
sentences.text: SportSG has also provided sport psychology resources to help the teams in their mental preparation for tournaments and I am told this is making a big difference.

sections.label: World Youth and SEA Tchoukball Championships
sections.summary: The Association will host the World Youth Championship 2023 and the South East Asia Tchoukball Championship 2023 at ActiveSG Pasir Ris Sport Centre, provided free by SportSG.

sentences.speaker: Mr Xie Yao Quan (Jurong)
sentences.text: In fact, in the next two weeks, the Association will be hosting the World Youth Championship 2023 and the South East Asia Tchoukball Championship 2023.

sentences.speaker: Mr Xie Yao Quan (Jurong)
sentences.text: These will be held at the ActiveSG Pasir Ris Sport Centre and I understand that SportSG has provided this venue free of charge.

sections.label: Bodies promoting local sports
sections.summary: Various bodies work together with a shared goal of promoting and developing sports locally, including MCCY, SportSG, NYSI, SNOC, MOE, Singapore Sports School, NSAs, private clubs and academies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: In Singapore, there are various bodies that work together with a shared goal of promotion and development of sports locally.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: There is MCCY, SportSG and the NYSI, the Singapore National Olympic Council (SNOC), the Ministry of Education (MOE), the Singapore Sports School, the NSAs, private clubs and academies.

sections.label: Singapore Aquatics mission swimmers
sections.summary: Singapore Aquatics states its mission is to make every Singaporean a swimmer.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: From Singapore Aquatics' perspective, our mission is to make every Singaporean a swimmer.

sections.label: World Aquatics Championships Fukuoka athletes
sections.summary: Singapore Aquatics will send 29 qualified athletes and 15 coaches and officials to the World Aquatics Championships in Fukuoka.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: At this juncture, I am really happy to report that Singapore Aquatics will be sending 11 swimmers, 12 artistic swimmers, three open water swimmers and three divers to the World Aquatics Championships in Fukuoka next week.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: All 29 athletes have qualified and are accompanied by 15 coaches and officials.

sections.label: spexScholarships and administrator upskilling
sections.summary: spexScholarships give athletes financial support, and administrators and scientists need upskilling to meet world-class team demands.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: For the top athletes who have the potential to do well on the global stage, we have the spexScholarships which give adequate financial support for our athletes to achieve and, as our athletes continue to improve and more frequently achieve global standards and results, we do need to upskill our administrators and scientists in order to meet the requirements, demands and complexity of having a world-class team, which is why I also believe that we should not only support our athletes but the teams which work with them as well.

sections.label: 2023 SEA Games medals and amendments
sections.summary: Singapore Aquatics won 23 gold, 16 silver and 12 bronze medals at the 2023 SEA Games in Cambodia, and an amendment was welcomed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: At the 2023 Southeast Asian Games in Cambodia, Singapore Aquatics returned with 23 gold, 16 silver and 12 bronze medals.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: As mentioned earlier, I would like to say that the NSAs, with Government and non-Government agencies, are consistently evaluating the systems and have clear, reliable, reasonable goals many years in advance.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: And I welcome the hon Member Mr Darryl David's amendments "That this House celebrates the accomplishments of our athletes and para-athletes, including at the 32nd Southeast Asian Games and the 12th ASEAN Para Games in Cambodia, and calls on the Government to continue its thorough evaluation of the areas of improvement in Singapore's sporting ecosystem, and commit to realising our goals in sports over the coming decade." Deputy Speaker, I have had a very exciting sporting journey.

sections.label: Singapore sporting ecosystem balance
sections.summary: Singapore has a good ecosystem balancing Government, non-government and private sector needs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Hand on heart, Singapore has a good ecosystem which balances Government, non-government and private sector needs.

sections.label: CMPB enlistment and post-career injuries
sections.summary: The speaker enlisted at CMPB on crutches and acknowledged suggestions about post-career injuries and athlete support.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: I actually went to Central Manpower Base (CMPB) and enlisted, on crutches.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: And I would like to acknowledge hon Sylvia Lim's suggestions about post-career injuries and how we can better support our athletes.

sections.label: MINDEF deferment for national athletes
sections.summary: MINDEF has allowed short and long-term deferments for national athletes and met NSAs in November 2022 to discuss NS schemes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: To be fair, the Ministry of Defence (MINDEF) has allowed short-term and long-term deferments to allow national athletes to pursue their athletic goals before enlisting.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: What is even more encouraging is that MINDEF has started to engage directly with NSAs through MCCY.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: In November 2022, MINDEF met up with the NSAs to talk about NS and its schemes to support our sportsmen.

sections.label: SNOC door not closed for Rui Yong
sections.summary: The speaker says decisions rest with SNOC and the door is probably not closed if Rui Yong is truly sorry.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay
sentences.text: Again, I think sports is a continuing journey.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay
sentences.text: I do not speak on behalf of SNOC, but I think the door is not closed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay
sentences.text: Again, these are decisions made by SNOC and not by myself.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mark Chay
sentences.text: I think if Rui Yong is truly sorry and he really wants to move forward and wants to be a great ambassador for sports, the door is probably not closed.

sections.label: SEA Games medal and record results
sections.summary: At the recent SEA Games athletes won 51 golds, 43 silvers and 64 bronzes, plus eight Games records, 17 national records and 40 personal bests.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: At the recent SEA Games, our athletes delivered stellar results – 51 golds, 43 silvers, 64 bronzes – sixth not seventh, that Assoc Prof Jamus Lim mentioned earlier, in the medal tally table.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: What is perhaps even more important were the eight Games records, 17 national records and 40 personal bests (PBs).

sections.label: Debutants share of gold medals
sections.summary: Debutants won 30% of Team Singapore gold medals.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: Debutants won 30% of Team Singapore gold medals.

sections.label: Para-athletes SEA Games results
sections.summary: Para-athletes won 12 golds, 15 silvers and 17 bronzes and set nine Games records, 16 national records and 17 personal bests from 25 athletes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: Our para-athletes were also outstanding –12 golds, 15 silvers and 17 bronzes; smashed nine Games records, 16 national records and 17 personal bests, all from a small contingent of 25 para-athletes.

sections.label: Annual spending on sports facilities
sections.summary: Based on the last three to five years, an average of S$90 million is spent annually to develop and operate public sports facilities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: Based on the last three to five years, an average of S$90 million is spent annually to develop and operate stadiums, running tracks, sports halls, pools and other public facilities.

sections.label: Dual-Use Scheme sports facilities
sections.summary: The Dual-Use Scheme makes 140 indoor sports halls and 100 school fields available to the public, roughly half free.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: For now, Samuel is glad that the Dual-Use Scheme (DUS) is in place because that means that 140 indoor sports halls and 100 school fields, roughly half of which are free, are readily made available to the public.

sections.label: Sports School athletes' SEA Games medals
sections.summary: Two-thirds of medal-winning athletes and 58% of debutants at the 2023 SEA Games were from the Sports School.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: For instance, two-thirds of our athletes winning medals and 58% of debutants at the 2023 SEA Games were from the Sports School.

sections.label: Juliet's SEA Games sabre medals
sections.summary: Juliet became the first JSA graduate to win Women's Individual Sabre gold and joint Women's Team Sabre bronze at her debut SEA Games.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: At the recent SEA Games, Juliet became the first JSA graduate to win a gold medal in the Women's Individual Sabre and also winning a joint bronze in the Women's Team Sabre in her debut SEA Games outing – all while excelling in her studies and managing a GPA of 3.55 out of 4 in the Ngee Ann Polytechnic Sports School Diploma Programme in Business Studies.

sections.label: Athlete support schemes and partners
sections.summary: SportSG agreements with 16 partner Institutes of Higher Learning benefited over 600 athletes since 2013, alongside spexBusiness, spexTAG and spexGLOW support.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: The scheme has been made possible through agreements between SportSG and 16 partner Institutes of Higher Learning and has benefited more than 600 athletes since 2013.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: Nevertheless, Samuel is grateful that spexBusiness partners, including Grab, MOH Holdings and Nestle, hire around 390 athletes, which provide for flexible work arrangements to support their training and competition schedules.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: This is in addition to spexTAG or Training Assistance Grant, which helps to defray athletes' training cost, as well as spexGLOW or Grant for Loss of Wages, which offsets lost wages sustained from missing work due to preparation or competition at the major games.

sections.label: Kean Yew's world championship funding
sections.summary: This played a pivotal role in Kean Yew winning the 2021 BWF World Championships, and Dubai training camps were funded by spexScholarship.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: This played a pivotal role in Kean Yew winning the BWF World Championships in 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: This and subsequent Dubai training camps were also funded by the spexScholarship programme.

sections.label: Aini and Diroy's ASEAN Para Games medals
sections.summary: Aini won Singapore's first women's para-powerlifting medals, and Muhammad Diroy defended his ASEAN Para Games men's Shot Put gold.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: Since then, Aini has continued her steady ascent, making history at the recent ASEAN Para Games, winning Singapore's first ever medals in women's para-powerlifting through her two bronze medals for the Women Up to 50 kilogrammes in the Best Lift and the Total Lift events.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
