sentences.text: One example is Muhammad Diroy, who, with the support of his coach and an SSI biomechanist, adopted a new individualised technique that enabled him to defend his gold medal at the ASEAN Para Games men's Shot Put event.

sections.label: Inclusive gyms and disability sports participation
sections.summary: SportSG has set up eight inclusive ActiveSG gyms, aims for all 27 gyms inclusive by 2026, and disability sports participation rose from 30% in 2015 to 54% in 2022.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: One key thrust to achieve this target is inclusive facilities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: I am glad to share that SportSG has set up eight inclusive ActiveSG gyms and are on track to make all 27 gyms inclusive by 2026.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: I am also heartened that persons with disabilities' participation in sports has increased from 30% in 2015 to 54% in 2022.

sections.label: Disability Sports Master Plan update
sections.summary: Sports is a focal area under the Enabling Masterplan 2030, and an update of the Disability Sports Master Plan aims to share results and next steps next year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: That is why sports are one of our focal areas under the Enabling Masterplan 2030.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: That is also why we embarked on an update of the Disability Sports Master Plan (DSMP) and aim to share the results of our update next year as well as the next steps to make sports more inclusive.

sections.label: Venue rental fees waived for FAS
sections.summary: For recent football friendlies against Papua New Guinea and Solomon Islands, Kallang Alive Sports Management waived venue rental fees for FAS and subsidised third-party pass-through costs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: For the recent football friendlies against Papua New Guinea and Solomon Islands, Kallang Alive Sports Management Company Limited had waived the venue rental fees for the Football Association of Singapore (FAS) in addition to further subsidising third-party pass-through costs incurred by FAS.

sections.label: Large-scale community festivals at Sports Hub
sections.summary: For the first time, large-scale community festivals were organised at the Sports Hub, attracting more than 50,000 participants in one shot.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: For the first time, we were able to organise large-scale community festivals at the Sports Hub, attracting more than 50,000 participants in one shot.

sections.label: Access, sporting culture, athlete support
sections.summary: Measures include broad sports access through SportCares and ActiveSG credits, building sporting culture via the Sports Hub and events, and supporting athletes and para-athletes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: And that includes, one, broad access to sports through community programmes and infrastructure, regardless of socio-economic status.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: This is why we have the SportCares programmes and have topped up $100 worth of ActiveSG credits for all Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents aged four to 12.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: Second, we will continue building a vibrant sporting culture.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: That is why we took back the Sports Hub because we believe in its potential to drive community sports.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: In 2023, school events returned to the Sports Hub, including 42 National School Games Finals.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: We also aim to host more world-class sporting events, having added FIBA Intercontinental Cup – that will come to Asia for the very first time – to the already burgeoning list of marquee events, including the Singapore Smash and Rugby Sevens that I had mentioned earlier.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Eric Chua)
sentences.text: Third, supporting our athletes and para-athletes to maximise their potential by providing them with financial support as well as non-financial support, including coaches, psychologists, scientists, amongst others.

sections.label: Sporting participation and economic success research
sections.summary: Research shows strong associations between sporting participation and economic success measures, and hosting events and athletic success are associated with improved life satisfaction.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: Research has shown that there are strong associations between sporting participation and measures of economic success, such as per capita incomes and economic freedoms.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: Hosting sporting events and national athletic success are, likewise, associated with improved life satisfaction.

sections.label: Singapore shortfall in sport
sections.summary: The passage says Singapore falls short in sport unlike its successes in other national endeavours.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: Well, even as we rightly celebrate the success, let us not be afraid to accept the reality of how, unlike our successes in other national endeavours, from top airline and airport to among the top Asian universities to even some of the highest per capita incomes in the world, we simply fall short when it comes to sport.

sections.label: SEA Games medal ranking
sections.summary: The passage states Singapore ranked sixth at the recent SEA Games, with 51 golds and 157 medals.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: To reiterate, I am, indeed, aware that we were ranked sixth in the recent SEA Games, but this is because medal types are counted differently and having secured 51 golds to Malaysia's 34, we ranked one above the latter, but they had 175 medals to our 157.

sections.label: Sport under-investment and football goals
sections.summary: The passage says Singapore under-invests and underachieves in sport, and cites football goals and past results.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: Still, it is fair to note, as I did in my opening speech, that we do not only appear to systematically under-invest in sport, but we also appear to underachieve relative to how much we put in.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: For football, our almost national sport, Mr Faisal Manap did point out that the medium-term goal of qualifying for the AFC Asian Cup by 2026 was not just aspirational, but potentially realisable.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: We could also chase the SEA Games football goal in a decade.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: These strike us as eminently reasonable, especially since Singapore had in 1974 won the Southeast Asian Peninsula Games – the predecessor to the SEA Games – and secured silver over multiple years in the SEA Games football tournaments between 1983 and 1989 while also taking a bronze as recently as 2013.

sections.label: Rejecting Darryl David amendments
sections.summary: The passage states the proposed amendments by Member Darryl David cannot be accepted in full.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: Given what I have shared above, it will be of little surprise that we are unable to accept the proposed amendments made by Member Darryl David in full.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: We thank Mr Darryl David for the suggested amendments.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: We find it somewhat more difficult to accept the second amendment although we would be willing to stand corrected.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: While we accept that the Government has intimated that they have performed a number of reviews and continue to monitor performance, we have not seen the concrete fruits of such thorough evaluations for the sporting ecosystem as a whole.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: So, unless the Government will commit to a future date where they will release a report or review documenting this effort – I understand that the report for football will be coming soon, but not for the system as a whole – we will be unable to support this particular amendment.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: We are also unable to support the third amendment.

sections.label: National Sport Participation Survey 2022
sections.summary: The passage states the National Sport Participation Survey shows exercise and sporting activities reached an all-time high in 2022.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: The National Sport Participation Survey (NSPS) reveals that exercise and sporting activities reach an all-time high in 2022.

sections.label: Debate conclusion and amendments
sections.summary: The passage describes a 2.4 kilometre run as success and puts three amendments to the House.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: For me, running 2.4 kilometres in 15 minutes is a "success".

sentences.speaker: Mdm Deputy Speaker
sentences.text: We have now come to the conclusion of the debate and I shall put the questions to the House for decision.

sentences.speaker: Mdm Deputy Speaker
sentences.text: The first amendment is: "(1) In line 1, after the words 'athletes' and 'para-athletes', to insert ", including".

sentences.speaker: Mdm Deputy Speaker
sentences.text: The second amendment is: "(2) In line 3, to delete 'undertake a' and insert 'continue its'".

sentences.speaker: Mdm Deputy Speaker
sentences.text: The third amendment is: "(3) In line 4, to delete 'clear achievable goals for sporting success', and insert 'our goals in sports'".
